A virtual machine emulates an entire computer and includes a complete guest operating system.
Containers do not normally include a complete operating system. Instead, they share the host operating
system kernel while keeping applications and their environments isolated. Because containers share the
kernel, they are generally lighter and faster to start than virtual machines.
